# UC Santa Cruz <span class='zh-inline'>(加州大学圣克鲁兹分校)</span>

<img src="logos/ucsc.svg" alt="UC Santa Cruz identifier" width="150" style="display:block;margin:0 0 1.4rem 0">

An experimental campus near Silicon Valley whose AI course's Pacman projects became classics — both our projects 031 and 032 come from here.

> 硅谷附近的实验性校区，其人工智能课程的 Pacman 项目已成经典——我们的项目 031 与 032 都来自这里。

## Background (背景)

Founded in 1965 as an experimental public campus, its Information and Computer Science department formed in the late 1960s and the Baskin School of Engineering was named in 1997.

> 1965 年作为实验性公立校区创办，信息与计算机科学系在 1960 年代末成立，1997 年工程学院以 Baskin 命名。

## Notable people (名人)

**Sage Weil** (CS PhD 2007) — created the Ceph distributed storage system. **Jay Kreps** — co-founder of Confluent and contributor to Apache Kafka. Faculty include **David Haussler** (UCSC Genome Browser) and **Ira Pohl** (ACM Fellow).

> **Sage Weil**（2007 计算机博士）— 创建 Ceph 分布式存储系统。**Jay Kreps** — Confluent 联合创始人、Apache Kafka 贡献者。教师包括 **David Haussler**（UCSC 基因组浏览器）与 **Ira Pohl**（ACM 会士）。

## Notable CS courses (著名计算机课程)

CSE 140 Artificial Intelligence (p0/p1 are projects 031/032) · CSE 101 Data Structures and Algorithms · CSE 102 Analysis of Algorithms · CSE 120 Computer Architecture · CSE 130 Principles of System Design.

> CSE 140 人工智能（p0/p1 即项目 031/032）· CSE 101 数据结构与算法 · CSE 102 算法分析 · CSE 120 计算机体系结构 · CSE 130 系统设计原理。
